item.title: Orca vs Shark: Deep Ocean's Apex Predator Showdown
item.description:
Orca vs shark, the ocean's ultimate power struggle. Watch real footage and break down why killer whales have become the one predator most sharks actively avoid — including great whites.
Join this live stream as we go through real orca vs shark encounters, explain the pack-hunting tactics that make orcas so dominant, and look at how different shark species respond when an orca pod shows up in their territory.
Nature Frontiers brings you real ocean predator science — no cartoons, no filler, just the natural world at its most extreme. Subscribe for new apex predator breakdowns every week.
